_comment: SHA-256 of the Ulanzi firmware files this port calls into. libmi_ao.so and libzknet.so are trusted only with a recorded hash: the port passes hand-measured structures to them. The vendor application is also accepted when its ELF dynamic symbol table defines every function in `symbols`; those are the FlyThings app entry points and the SDK's base::wifiOnAndWait(int), which is all the launcher calls. Never add `symbols` to another library. Run `uv run tools/vendor_fingerprints.py capture CLOCK_IP` on a supported clock to record hashes, then rebuild.

libulanzi-bootstrap.so.purpose: the vendor application: the launcher starts Wi-Fi through it and falls back to it when the knob is held at power-on or AWTRIX fails to start three times

libmi_ao.so.purpose: Sigmastar audio output: the port passes hand-measured structures to it, so with another build audio (tones, MP3, radio) stays off

libzknet.so.purpose: vendor network library: DHCP after the launcher's first lease, static addressing and the fallback access point go through its C++ symbols, so with another build they stay off
